decisions.reason: The Android API-level and dependency updates do not alter the separate iOS modernization state; the iOS 15 and UIWebView decisions are already captured by their own same-message MODIFY.
Removing an unused Android permission is a separate store-compliance obligation and is not changed by targeting Android API 35 or updating dependencies.
The Android modernization change does not alter the independent requirement to include an iOS Privacy Manifest.
Android API and dependency modernization does not change the independent iOS certificate-renewal and signing-readiness requirement.
Code shrinking and image cleanup were separately accepted and already captured; the API-level and dependency update does not necessarily change the download-size requirement.
Targeting Android API 35 and updating dependencies does not change the independently confirmed full-application localization coverage.
The Android modernization decision does not resolve whether the Youku video should remain or be removed, and the later client decision cannot be used at this source time.
The Android-specific API and dependency change does not alter iOS full-application localization coverage.
Android API modernization does not necessarily change the independently required RTL layout behavior.
Android API-level and dependency updates do not alter the separate iOS Thinning distribution method.
The Android-specific modernization change does not alter the independent iOS RTL layout requirement.
